name: llplayer-codex
description: Repository-local Codex workflow for LLPlayer's C#/.NET/WPF Windows stack.

interface.longDescription: LLPlayer Codex provides repository-specific skills, verification rules, and ship guidance for the C#/.NET 10 WPF media player.
defaultPrompt: Use $llplayer-product-contract before changing product behavior, UI, runtime, config, or dependencies.
Use $llplayer-dotnet-rules before editing C#, XAML, csproj, or publish profiles.
Use $llplayer-quality-gate and spawned /review before final handoff.
Use $llplayer-packaging-release for Windows publish or release changes.
Use $llplayer-instruction-drift when changing Codex docs, skills, hooks, scripts, or agents.
Use $llplayer-ship before commit, push, PR, or release handoff.
